scenariosVerified.name: Two-Participant Journey
scenariosVerified.flow: Alice creates room 'Project Alpha', generates invite token. Bob accepts token and joins as 'editor'. Both verify personal workspaces remain completely isolated.

scenariosVerified.name: Member Lifecycle & Role Transitions
scenariosVerified.flow: Alice demotes Bob to 'viewer'. Bob attempts to send chat message or create room note; server returns 403 FORBIDDEN. Alice promotes Bob back to 'editor'; Bob successfully creates room note.

scenariosVerified.name: Ownership Transfer Invariant
scenariosVerified.flow: Alice transfers ownership to Bob. Bob becomes room 'owner'; Alice becomes 'editor'. Exactly one owner invariant is maintained throughout.

scenariosVerified.name: Explicit Personal-to-Room Item Copy
scenariosVerified.flow: Alice previews copy of personal note to room. System confirms source title, kind, and ownership transfer explanation. Alice confirms copy; destination note receives new UUID in room; personal original is untouched. Alice attempts to copy vault item or journal entry; system strictly blocks copy.

scenariosVerified.name: Chat Server Order & Idempotent Deduplication
scenariosVerified.flow: Alice and Bob exchange messages. Monotonic serverOrder sequences are assigned under state lock. Submitting duplicate clientMessageId returns original message idempotently without creating a second record.

scenariosVerified.name: Mute vs. Block vs. Leave/Remove
scenariosVerified.flow: Alice mutes room: notifications and unread badges suppressed, message history remains visible. Alice blocks Bob: Bob's messages are hidden for Alice only and future invitations between them are blocked, while Bob remains a member of the room. Alice removes Bob: access epoch rotates, Bob receives 403 MEMBERSHIP_REVOKED, Bob's client halts polling and purges local room cache.

scenariosVerified.name: UGC Report & Frozen Evidence
scenariosVerified.flow: Alice reports abusive message from Bob with category 'harassment'. Server creates report receipt with immutable evidenceSnapshot containing pre-edit message body, sender ID, room ID, and timestamp. Reporter identity is kept strictly confidential.

scenariosVerified.name: Web Operator Moderation Triage & RM-001 Enforcement
scenariosVerified.flow: Platform operator opens /developer/moderation. Filters for 'harassment' reports. Opens report detail drawer, reviews frozen evidence, inputs reason 'Violates acceptable use policy', selects disposition 'content_removed', and applies action. System soft-deletes message (deleted_at set, body cleared) and publishes 'room_message.deleted' event. Connected clients remove the message immediately.

scenariosVerified.name: Production Gate Fail-Closed
scenariosVerified.flow: System verifies that in production runtime (NODE_ENV=production), isRoomsLocallyEnabled() returns false, blocking room endpoints and chat streams until human staffing is complete.
